generatedIllustrations.prompt: Create a 16:9 landscape illustration for a university teacher workshop slide, not a poster. No text, no letters, no watermark. A tactile colorful paper-cut and clay-render composition on a clean very pale mint background: a real-looking open laptop with educational matching cards visible on its screen, a teacher's hand arranging question cards beside it, small coral, turquoise, sunny yellow and cobalt-blue learning tokens. Sophisticated editorial educational illustration, clear readable physical objects, asymmetrical composition with laptop centered toward right. Bright soft light, crisp detail, cheerful grown-up design. This will be a large visual on a slide about building interactive teaching games with AI.

A bright sophisticated editorial 3D paper-cut illustration for a university teacher presentation about multimodal educational media. Landscape 4:3 image, no text or letters. Clearly arranged physical objects: a turquoise microphone with coral audio waveform sculptural ribbon, a cobalt camera framing a botanical leaf photo, a yellow open book, and a white tablet showing geometric matching tiles. Each object fully visible, equal importance. Clean pale sky-blue studio backdrop, crisp tactile materials, warm daylight, vivid turquoise coral mustard yellow blue with white. A real teaching workbench with diverse media, not a sci-fi brain or robot, not a logo or infographic.
